_comment: R5-S11 modern-path uncertainty matrix. Classification vocabulary: SDK_PROVEN (mechanically recovered from shipped SDK bytecode), EMULATOR_INTEGRATION_PROVEN (verified end-to-end on the synthetic harness, not on hardware), INFERRED (constrained by SDK evidence but not forced by it), HARNESS_POLICY (test-harness choice, not a device claim), UNKNOWN (no evidence; must not be emulated as fact).

behaviors.behavior: FE11 marker = 65041 (STICK_PREHANDSHAKE_CNF)
behaviors.evidence: javap v4/w$a + z$c dispatch literal; R5-S10 verifier

behaviors.behavior: FE12 marker = 65042 both directions
behaviors.evidence: javap w$c.c/w$a.b + z$c 65042 arm; R5-S10 verifier

behaviors.evidence: javap v4.getBleRequestType (65056 iff d else 65040); R5-S10 verifier

behaviors.evidence: javap newest-match dispatch + i3==length-1 gate; R5-S10 verifier + test_no_fe11_until_all_v4_chunks_received

behaviors.evidence: javap v4.enPkg merge order; evidence-digest; R5-S10 verifier

behaviors.evidence: javap z$c 217-341 incl. dedupe log + sort; evidence-digest

behaviors.evidence: javap q5.a + AudioDecryptor PKCS8-only + native JNI names

behaviors.evidence: javap z$c 482-576 incl. guards + literal; evidence-digest
